regions.merged_text: Just uncovering Tin's letter of Jan. 13 I determined without further delay write you at least a few lines. - Better waiting for time to write a letter. First I've been wanting, it seem to ne two months, to thank for that second deliver; from the "Grove" - if anything an improvement on the Ist. The Brethren surely appreciated then. Then Many thanks for your mission-activity - and Win's too - in the many enrollments, including the old simmer who has given us here so much conscience trouble, Fr. Solenus - and the other features of your monthly donations - so often (as must seen to you) unappreciated. I do hope you are both enjoying your vacation in your sumy S.Western sojoum Praised be Jesus and Mary.
